labels.shortDescription: Settings setup note: button that reads the Setup check again
labels.value: Check Again

labels.shortDescription: Settings setup note: the prerequisite is already done
labels.value: Done

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Duplicate Matching: clicks in Setup, separated by |
labels.value: Click Standard Contact Duplicate Rule.|If it says Inactive, click Activate.|Do the same for Standard Account Duplicate Rule.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Duplicate Matching: what to change for duplicates
labels.value: To review duplicates, keep the standard duplicate rules active. Give the people who will review them Duplicate Review on the Access page, under Extra Permissions.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Duplicate Matching: why duplicates need Setup
labels.value: A scan applies only active duplicate rules, and Salesforce shows possible duplicates only to users with a Sales Cloud or Service Cloud license.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Error Log: clicks in Setup, separated by |
labels.value: Under Access to Send Email, set Access level to All email.|Click Save.|Come back here and click Check Again.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Error Log: what to change for email
labels.value: Let this org send email, so the error digest can be delivered.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Error Log: why email needs Setup
labels.value: Salesforce sends no digest unless Deliverability is set to All email, and only Setup can change it.

labels.shortDescription: Settings setup note: heading above what to change in Setup
labels.value: Needs a Change in Setup

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, General: clicks in Setup, separated by |
labels.value: Tick Deploy Metadata from Non-Certified Package Versions via Apex.|Click Save.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, General: what to change for Custom Metadata
labels.value: To save Custom Metadata entries here, turn on Deploy Metadata from Non-Certified Package Versions via Apex. Give yourself Metadata Admin on the Access page, under Extra Permissions.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, General: why Custom Metadata needs Setup
labels.value: Salesforce lets an installed package change the org's metadata only with this switch on, and only Setup can turn it on.

labels.shortDescription: Settings setup note: screen reader text after Open in Setup
labels.value: (opens in a new tab)

labels.shortDescription: Settings setup note: the prerequisite is not done yet
labels.value: Not done yet

labels.shortDescription: Settings setup note: button that opens the Setup page
labels.value: Open in Setup

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Rollups: clicks in Setup, separated by |
labels.value: Click the object the rollup totals onto, such as Contact or Account.|Click Fields & Relationships, then New.|Choose Number, Currency or Date to match the rollup, then follow the steps to Save.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Rollups: what to change for a new rollup
labels.value: Create the field a new rollup writes its total to before you build the rollup.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Rollups: why rollup fields need Setup
labels.value: The Rollup Builder picks a field that already exists, and only Setup creates fields.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Access: clicks in Setup, separated by |
labels.value: Click the module's permission set.|Click Manage Assignments, then Add Assignment.|Tick the people, then click Next and Assign.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Access: what to change for module access
labels.value: Assign an installed module's permission set that this page does not list under Extra Permissions to the people who need it.

labels.shortDescription: Setup note, Access: why module permission sets need Setup
labels.value: Core's extra permissions and every permission set a module lists here are given on this page; any other is assigned in Setup.
